title: Single-use fixed channels and actual observation prices have explicit contracts
statement: For one fixed independent channel Y_i per latent coordinate, g(Y)=E[f(X)|all Y] and every legal signal-selection policy satisfies R_f(pi)=R_floor+R_g(pi). Known BSC correlations rho_i attenuate linear/pair coefficients by rho_i/rho_i rho_j. Repeated sensing/adaptive channel selection/correlated noise are outside this interface. For c_i>0 rank I_i/c_i; expected adaptive cost B uses prefix target3 kappa d^2 B/epsilon^2 with overshoot<=max c_i. A hard budget separately excludes candidates costing>B while retaining their target uncertainty. Coefficient error<=nu adds(1+L+binom(L,2))nu^2. Two INDEPENDENT noisy difference banks give variance<=2I_i^2+sigma^2 I_i+sigma^4/4, require2(n+1) reads/context and paid influence-floor calibration; evaluation-certificate failure joins the confidence bill.

requires: Known fixed independent single-use measurement channels, or known positive costs under the specified expected/hard budget model.
Acquired coefficients/channel parameters with simultaneous error/confidence certificates.
Independent scalar-noise banks for the noisy influence product, preserving source/floor cost.

costs: With s listed quadratic coefficients, scores O(s+n) arithmetic/O(n) storage, linear selection or O(n log n) sorting, then L physical observations plus O(L+s_T) prediction work. Dense input costsTheta(n^2) to read.

General list L=min(n,ceil(3 kappa d^2 k/epsilon^2)),d>=2,0<epsilon<=1; unbiased quadratic improves to min of n,ceil(36k/epsilon^2),ceil((16k/epsilon)log(32e/epsilon)). At10% tolerance the latter is about1083k before cap.

Acquisition evaluations, complete input submission, calibration, coefficient bit growth, noisy-channel qualification and additive model/precision errors are charged. No useful large-system operational advantage is demonstrated.
